    async def _find_empty_required_fields(self, page) -> list:
        """
        Найти все видимые обязательные поля которые пустые.
        Возвращает список label-строк пустых полей.
        """
        empty = []
        seen_ids = set()

        # Все input/textarea/select с aria-required или required
        candidates = await page.query_selector_all(
            "input[aria-required='true'], input[required], "
            "select[aria-required='true'], select[required], "
            "textarea[aria-required='true'], textarea[required]"
        )
        for el in candidates:
            el_type = (await el.get_attribute("type") or "text").lower()
            if el_type in ("hidden", "file", "submit", "button", "reset", "image"):
                continue
            if not await el.is_visible():
                continue
            # Combobox инпуты (role='combobox') обрабатываются отдельно ниже —
            # input_value() для react-select всегда "" даже после выбора
            el_role = (await el.get_attribute("role") or "").lower()
            if el_role == "combobox":
                continue
            el_id = await el.get_attribute("id") or ""
            if el_id in seen_ids:
                continue
            seen_ids.add(el_id)

            tag = await el.evaluate("e => e.tagName.toLowerCase()")
            if tag == "select":
                val = await el.evaluate(
                    "e => e.selectedIndex <= 0 ? '' : (e.options[e.selectedIndex]?.value || '')"
                )
            else:
                val = await el.input_value()

            if not val.strip():
                label = await self._get_label(page, el)
                empty.append(label or el_id or "unknown")

        # Также проверяем combobox (React Select — не имеет native required)
        # Их обязательность определяем по aria-required на самом input
        # ВАЖНО: после выбора input_value() = "" (react-select очищает текстовый инпут).
        # Реальное значение — в [class*='single-value'] контейнере рядом с инпутом.
        combos = await page.query_selector_all("input[role='combobox'][aria-required='true']")
        for el in combos:
            if not await el.is_visible():
                continue
            el_id = await el.get_attribute("id") or ""
            if el_id in seen_ids:
                continue
            seen_ids.add(el_id)
            # Проверяем заполнен ли react-select combobox.
            # Greenhouse использует emotion CSS-in-JS с чистыми хешами (css-1abc234) —
            # class-based селекторы ненадёжны. Главный метод — структурный (M5).
            val = await el.evaluate("""
                (el) => {
                    // ── M5: Структурный (не требует читаемых class-имён) ─────────────────
                    // react-select structure: ValueContainer > [singleValue|placeholder, Input > el]
                    // Когда заполнено: singleValue видим + placeholder скрыт (display:none)
                    // Когда пусто:     только placeholder видим, hidden-siblings нет
                    const inputWrapper = el.parentElement;
                    const vc5 = inputWrapper && inputWrapper.parentElement;
                    if (vc5) {
                        let visText = null, hasHiddenSibling = false;
                        for (const child of vc5.children) {
                            if (child === inputWrapper || child.contains(el)) continue;
                            // Пропускаем indicator-иконки (стрелка, крестик)
                            if (child.querySelector && child.querySelector('svg')) continue;
                            const st = window.getComputedStyle(child);
                            const t = child.innerText && child.innerText.trim();
                            if (!t) continue;
                            if (st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden' || child.offsetParent === null) {
                                hasHiddenSibling = true;
                            } else {
                                visText = t;
                            }
                        }
                        // Заполнено: есть видимый текст (value) И скрытый sibling (placeholder)
                        if (visText && hasHiddenSibling) return 'M5:' + visText;
                    }

                    // ── Class-based методы (запасные — работают при семантических классах) ─
                    // Пробуем первые 4 ancestor-а (не closest() — может уйти слишком далеко)
                    const ancestors = [];
                    let node = el;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        node = node.parentElement;
                        if (!node) break;
                        ancestors.push(node);
                        if (i >= 3) break;
                    }

                    // M1: single-value class
                    for (const anc of ancestors) {
                        const sv = anc.querySelector(
                            '[class*="single-value"],[class*="singleValue"],[class*="-singleValue"],[class*="SingleValue"]'
                        );
                        if (sv) {
                            const st = window.getComputedStyle(sv);
                            if (st.display !== 'none' && st.visibility !== 'hidden' && sv.offsetParent !== null) {
                                const t = sv.innerText && sv.innerText.trim();
                                if (t) return 'M1:' + t;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // M2: placeholder visibility (react-select всегда скрывает при выборе)
                    for (const anc of ancestors) {
                        const ph = anc.querySelector(
                            '[class*="placeholder"],[class*="-placeholder"],[class*="Placeholder"]'
                        );
                        if (ph) {
                            const st = window.getComputedStyle(ph);
                            const hidden = st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden' || ph.offsetParent === null;
                            return hidden ? 'M2:__has_value__' : 'M2:__empty__';
                        }
                    }

                    // M3: ValueContainer children
                    for (const anc of ancestors) {
                        const vcEl = anc.querySelector(
                            '[class*="ValueContainer"],[class*="value-container"],[class*="-value-container"],[class*="values"]'
                        );
                        if (vcEl) {
                            for (const child of vcEl.children) {
                                if (child.tagName === 'INPUT' || child.contains(el)) continue;
                                const st = window.getComputedStyle(child);
                                if (st.display === 'none') continue;
                                if ((child.className || '').toLowerCase().includes('placeholder')) continue;
                                const t = child.innerText && child.innerText.trim();
                                if (t) return 'M3:' + t;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // M4: aria-selected
                    for (const anc of ancestors) {
                        const sel = anc.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"]');
                        if (sel && sel.offsetParent !== null) {
                            const t = sel.innerText && sel.innerText.trim();
                            if (t) return 'M4:' + t;
                        }
                    }

                    return el.value || '';
                }
            """)
            raw = val.strip()
            # JS возвращает: 'Mx:value' или 'M2:__has_value__' = заполнено
            #                'M2:__empty__' или '' = пусто
            is_empty = (not raw) or (raw == "M2:__empty__")
            logger.debug(f"Combobox '{el_id}': raw='{raw[:60]}' → {'EMPTY' if is_empty else 'FILLED'}")
            if is_empty:
                label = await self._get_label(page, el)
                empty.append(label or el_id or "unknown combobox")

        return empty

    async def _handle_security_code(self, page, job) -> bool:
        """
        Обработать Greenhouse Email Verification (Security Code).

        После submit Greenhouse иногда показывает форму с полем для ввода
        кода из письма — это стандартная email-верификация, НЕ CAPTCHA.

        Стратегия (полностью автоматическая):
          1. Проверить появилось ли поле для security code
          2. Если да — через GmailCodeReader читаем код из почты
          3. Заполнить поле и нажать Submit сноваа

        Returns:
            True если security code был обнаружен и обработан
        """
        # Селекторы для поля security code (Greenhouse использует разные варианты)
        CODE_SELECTORS = [
            "input[name*='security']",
            "input[placeholder*='security' i]",
            "input[placeholder*='code' i]",
            "input[aria-label*='security' i]",
            "input[aria-label*='code' i]",
            "input[id*='security']",
            "input[id*='code'][type='text']",
            "input[autocomplete='one-time-code']",
        ]
        code_el = None
        for sel in CODE_SELECTORS:
            el = await page.query_selector(sel)
            if el and await el.is_visible():
                code_el = el
                logger.info(f"🔐 Greenhouse: обнаружен security code field ({sel})")
                break

        if not code_el:
            # Дополнительная проверка по тексту на странице
            page_text = await page.evaluate("() => document.body.innerText")
            security_keywords = ["security code", "verification code", "confirm your email",
                                  "enter the code", "check your email"]
            if not any(kw in page_text.lower() for kw in security_keywords):
                return False  # Никакого security code нет

            # Текст есть, но поле не нашли — попробуем найти любой видимый text input
            all_inputs = await page.query_selector_all("input[type='text'], input[type='number']")
            for inp in all_inputs:
                if await inp.is_visible():
                    val = (await inp.input_value()).strip()
                    if not val:
                        code_el = inp
                        logger.info("🔐 Greenhouse: security code field найден по тексту страницы")
                        break

        if not code_el:
            logger.debug("🔐 Greenhouse: security code field не обнаружен")
            return False

        # Скриншот — видим что случилось
        safe_company = job.company.lower().replace(' ', '_').replace('/', '_')
        code_screenshot = SCREENSHOTS_DIR / f"gh_{safe_company}_security_code.png"
        await page.screenshot(path=str(code_screenshot), full_page=False)
        logger.info(f"📸 Security code screenshot: {code_screenshot}")

        # Автоматически читаем код из Gmail
        email_addr = self.bank.get_answer("email") or ""
        code = None

        gmail_reader = GmailCodeReader.from_env(email_addr)
        if gmail_reader:
            logger.info(f"📧 GmailReader: ждём письмо от Greenhouse на {email_addr}...")
            # Читаем в отдельном потоке — не блокируем event loop
            import asyncio
            code = await asyncio.to_thread(
                gmail_reader.fetch_security_code,
                30,   # ждём письмо макс 30 секунд
                3,    # проверяем каждые 3 секунды
            )
        else:
            logger.warning(
                "📧 GmailReader: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD не настроен.\n"
                "   Добавьте GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD в .env и повторите."
            )

        if not code:
            logger.error("🔐 Greenhouse: security code не получен — пропускаем submit")
            return False

        # Вводим код автоматически
        # Greenhouse security code — 8 ОТДЕЛЬНЫХ input полей (по символу).
        # fill() вводит весь текст в одно поле; type() печатает по символу
        # и Greenhouse автоматически переключает фокус на следующее поле.
        await code_el.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        await page.keyboard.type(code.strip(), delay=120)
        await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.0))
        logger.info(f"🔐 Greenhouse: security code введён автоматически: '{code}'")

        # Нажать Submit снова
        submit_btn = await page.query_selector(SELECTORS["submit"])
        if submit_btn and await submit_btn.is_visible():
            await human_click_safe(page, submit_btn)
            logger.info("🖱️ Greenhouse: повторный Submit после security code")
        else:
            await code_el.press("Enter")
            logger.info("🖱️ Greenhouse: Enter в поле security code (submit btn не найден)")

        return True

    async def _fill(self, page, selector: str, value: str):
        """Заполнить поле если существует, видимо, включено и пустое."""
        if not value:
            return
        try:
            el = await page.query_selector(selector)
            if el and await el.is_visible() and await el.is_enabled():
                current = await el.input_value()
                if not current.strip():
                    await el.click()
                    await el.fill(value)
                    await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.2, 0.5))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Greenhouse _fill: {selector} → {e}")

    async def _fill_combobox(self, page, selector: str, value: str):
        """
        Заполнить React combobox (Greenhouse Country, Work Auth, Education и т.д.).

        3-этапная стратегия (раз и навсегда):
          1. Click-open → ищем опцию БЕЗ ввода текста (для чистых dropdown типа Education)
          2. Type-filter → вводим текст → ищем опцию в отфильтрованном списке
          3. Keyboard fallback → Enter (выбрать первую совпавшую)
        """
        if not value:
            return
        try:
            el = await page.query_selector(selector)
            if not el or not await el.is_visible() or not await el.is_enabled():
                return
            await self._fill_combobox_el(page, el, value, label_hint=selector)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Greenhouse _fill_combobox wrapper: {selector} → {e}")

    async def _upload_file(self, page, selector: str, file_path: Path):
        """Загрузить файл в input[type='file']. Берёт первый видимый элемент."""
        try:
            els = await page.query_selector_all(selector)
            if not els:
                return
            # Берём первый видимый file input (или первый в списке если все скрыты)
            # NOTE: next() + await несовместимы — используем явный цикл
            el = None
            for e in els:
                if await e.is_visible():
                    el = e
                    break
            el = el or els[0]
            await el.set_input_files(str(file_path))
            await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.5))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Greenhouse file upload failed ({selector}): {e}")

    async def _upload_resume(self, page, file_path: Path):
        """Загрузить резюме — сначала по aria-label, потом первый file input."""
        for sel in [
            "input[type='file'][aria-label*='resume' i]",
            "input[type='file'][aria-label*='cv' i]",
        ]:
            el = await page.query_selector(sel)
            if el and await el.is_visible():
                try:
                    await el.set_input_files(str(file_path))
                    await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.5))
                    return
                except Exception:
                    continue
        # Fallback: первый видимый file input
        await self._upload_file(page, "input[type='file']", file_path)

    async def _upload_cover_letter(self, page, file_path: Path):
        """Загрузить cover letter — по aria-label или второй file input."""
        for sel in [
            "input[type='file'][aria-label*='cover' i]",
            "input[type='file'][aria-label*='letter' i]",
        ]:
            el = await page.query_selector(sel)
            if el and await el.is_visible():
                try:
                    await el.set_input_files(str(file_path))
                    await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.5))
                    return
                except Exception:
                    continue
        # Fallback: второй file input (первый = resume)
        all_files = await page.query_selector_all("input[type='file']")
        if len(all_files) >= 2:
            try:
                await all_files[1].set_input_files(str(file_path))
                await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.5))
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Greenhouse: cover letter upload failed: {e}")

    async def _fill_custom_questions(self, page):
        """
        Универсальный заполнитель — находит ВСЕ видимые незаполненные поля.

        Pipeline для каждого поля:
          1. AnswerBank → автозаполнение если знает
          2. AI батч (Gemini) для незнакомых
          3. HITL терминальное меню для полей которые AI не смог ответить
             или ответил с низкой уверенностью на textarea
        """
        ctx = getattr(self, "_job_context", {})

        # ID полей уже заполненных в основном блоке — пропускаем
        SKIP_IDS = frozenset({
            "first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone", "country",
            "gender", "hispanic_ethnicity", "veteran_status", "disability_status",
        })

        unanswered_text: list = []   # [(element, label, is_textarea)]
        unanswered_combo: list = []  # [(element, el_id, label, is_native_select)]

        # ── Сканируем все text / textarea ──────────────────────────────────
        text_inputs = await page.query_selector_all(
            "input:not([type='hidden']):not([type='file']):not([type='submit'])"
            ":not([type='button']):not([type='reset']):not([type='image'])"
            ":not([type='radio']):not([type='checkbox']):not([role='combobox']), "
            "textarea"
        )
        for inp in text_inputs:
            el_id = await inp.get_attribute("id") or ""
            if el_id in SKIP_IDS:
                continue
            if not await inp.is_visible() or not await inp.is_enabled():
                continue
            if (await inp.input_value()).strip():
                continue
            label_text = await self._get_label(page, inp)
            if not label_text:
                continue
            answer = self.bank.get_answer(label_text)
            if answer:
                await inp.fill(answer)
                await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.2, 0.5))
                logger.info(f"✅ Bank → '{label_text[:50]}': '{answer}'")
            else:
                is_ta = await inp.evaluate("el => el.tagName.toLowerCase()") == "textarea"
                unanswered_text.append((inp, label_text, is_ta))

        # ── Сканируем все combobox / select ────────────────────────────────
        combo_inputs = await page.query_selector_all("input[role='combobox'], select")
        for combo in combo_inputs:
            el_id = await combo.get_attribute("id") or ""
            if el_id in SKIP_IDS:
                continue
            if not await combo.is_visible() or not await combo.is_enabled():
                continue
            tag = await combo.evaluate("el => el.tagName.toLowerCase()")
            is_native = (tag == "select")
            if is_native:
                current = await combo.evaluate(
                    "el => el.selectedIndex <= 0 ? '' : (el.options[el.selectedIndex]?.text || '')"
                )
            else:
                current = await combo.input_value()
            # Пропустить если уже заполнено (не пустое и не placeholder)
            if current.strip() and current.strip().lower() not in ("select...", "select", "choose...", "--"):
                continue
            label_text = await self._get_label(page, combo)
            if not label_text:
                continue
            answer = self.bank.get_answer(label_text)
            if answer:
                if is_native:
                    await self._fill_select_native(combo, answer)
                elif el_id:
                    await self._fill_combobox(page, f"#{el_id}", answer)
                else:
                    await self._fill_combobox_el(page, combo, answer, label_hint=label_text)
                logger.info(f"✅ Bank → combobox '{label_text[:50]}': '{answer}'")
            else:
                logger.warning(f"🤷 Bank не знает '{label_text[:60]}' → AI")
                unanswered_combo.append((combo, el_id, label_text, is_native))

        # ── AI батч для незнакомых ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if unanswered_text or unanswered_combo:
            logger.info(
                f"🤖 AI батч: {len(unanswered_text)} text + "
                f"{len(unanswered_combo)} combo — Gemini"
            )
            # textarea → ask_variants (для HITL с выбором); text/number → ask()
            text_coros = []
            text_use_variants = []
            for _, label, is_ta in unanswered_text:
                if is_ta:
                    text_coros.append(self.ai.ask_variants(label, field_type="textarea", context=ctx))
                    text_use_variants.append(True)
                else:
                    text_coros.append(self.ai.ask(label, field_type="text", context=ctx))
                    text_use_variants.append(False)

            combo_coros = [
                self.ai.ask(label, field_type="select", context=ctx)
                for _, _, label, _ in unanswered_combo
            ]

            all_results = await asyncio.gather(*text_coros, *combo_coros, return_exceptions=True)
            n_text = len(unanswered_text)
            text_results = all_results[:n_text]
            combo_results = all_results[n_text:]

            # Заполняем текстовые поля
            for (inp, label, is_ta), result, use_variants in zip(
                unanswered_text, text_results, text_use_variants
            ):
                if isinstance(result, Exception) or result is None:
                    logger.warning(f"⚠️ AI failed '{label[:60]}' → HITL")
                    answer = await self._hitl_for_field(label, "textarea" if is_ta else "text", [], ctx)
                elif use_variants:
                    # result = (variants, best_idx)
                    variants, best_idx = result
                    answer = await self._hitl.prompt(
                        question=label, field_type="textarea",
                        variants=variants, company=ctx.get("company", ""),
                        job_title=ctx.get("job_title", ""), default_idx=best_idx,
                    )
                else:
                    # result = AIAnswer; только low confidence → HITL
                    if result.confidence == "low":
                        answer = await self._hitl_for_field(
                            label, "text", [], ctx, default=result.answer
                        )
                    else:
                        answer = result.answer
                        logger.info(f"✅ AI → '{label[:50]}': '{answer}'")

                if answer:
                    try:
                        await inp.fill(answer)
                        await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.2, 0.5))
                        if is_ta:
                            self.ai.set_cached_answer(label, answer)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.debug(f"fill text '{label[:30]}': {e}")

            # Заполняем combobox / select
            for (combo, el_id, label, is_native), result in zip(unanswered_combo, combo_results):
                if isinstance(result, Exception) or result is None:
                    logger.warning(f"⚠️ AI failed combo '{label[:60]}' → HITL")
                    answer = await self._hitl_for_field(label, "select", [], ctx)
                elif result.confidence == "low":
                    answer = await self._hitl_for_field(
                        label, "select", [], ctx, default=result.answer
                    )
                else:
                    answer = result.answer
                    logger.info(f"✅ AI → combo '{label[:50]}': '{answer}' (conf={result.confidence})")

                if answer:
                    try:
                        if is_native:
                            await self._fill_select_native(combo, answer)
                        elif el_id:
                            await self._fill_combobox(page, f"#{el_id}", answer)
                        else:
                            await self._fill_combobox_el(page, combo, answer, label_hint=label)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.debug(f"fill combo '{label[:30]}': {e}")

        # ── Radio кнопки (универсально) ─────────────────────────────────────
        await self._fill_radios_universal(page, ctx)

    async def _fill_radios_universal(self, page, ctx: dict = None):
        """Universal radio filler — не ограничен question_ префиксом."""
        ctx = ctx or {}
        try:
            radios = await page.query_selector_all("input[type='radio']")
            seen_groups: set = set()
            for radio in radios:
                name = await radio.get_attribute("name") or ""
                el_id = await radio.get_attribute("id") or ""
                # Группируем по name (надёжнее всего) или по id-префиксу
                m = re.match(r"([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)", el_id)
                group_key = name or (m.group(1) if m else el_id)
                if not group_key or group_key in seen_groups:
                    continue
                seen_groups.add(group_key)

                group_label = await page.evaluate("""
                    (el) => {
                        const fieldset = el.closest('fieldset');
                        if (fieldset) {
                            const legend = fieldset.querySelector('legend');
                            if (legend) return legend.innerText.trim();
                        }
                        const container = el.closest(
                            '.field, .form-field, [class*="question"], [class*="group"]'
                        );
                        if (container) {
                            const lbl = container.querySelector(
                                'label:not([for]), .label, legend, h3, p'
                            );
                            if (lbl) return lbl.innerText.trim();
                        }
                        return '';
                    }
                """, radio)
                if not group_label:
                    continue

                # Собираем доступные опции
                if name:
                    all_group = await page.query_selector_all(
                        f"input[type='radio'][name='{name}']"
                    )
                else:
                    prefix = m.group(1) if m else el_id
                    all_group = await page.query_selector_all(
                        f"input[type='radio'][id^='{prefix}']"
                    )
                options = []
                for opt in all_group:
                    opt_label = await self._get_label(page, opt)
                    if opt_label:
                        options.append(opt_label)

                answer = self.bank.get_answer(group_label)
                if not answer:
                    # AI для незнакомых radio
                    try:
                        ai_res = await self.ai.ask(
                            group_label, field_type="radio", options=options, context=ctx
                        )
                        answer = ai_res.answer if ai_res else None
                    except Exception:
                        answer = None
                if not answer:
                    continue

                for opt in all_group:
                    opt_value = (await opt.get_attribute("value") or "").lower()
                    opt_label = await self._get_label(page, opt)
                    if answer.lower() in opt_value or answer.lower() in (opt_label or "").lower():
                        await opt.check()
                        await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.2, 0.4))
                        logger.info(f"✅ Radio '{group_label[:40]}' → '{opt_label or opt_value}'")
                        break
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Radio fill: {e}")

    async def _fill_after_other(self, page, combobox_el, value: str, hint: str = ""):
        """
        После выбора 'Other' в combobox — ищем появившийся текстовый input
        и вводим туда оригинальное значение.

        Greenhouse и другие формы часто показывают 'Please specify' / 'Other (specify)'
        текстовое поле после выбора Other в dropdown для School, Degree и т.д.
        """
        try:
            await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.4, 0.7))  # ждём появления нового поля
            # Ищем любой новый пустой text input рядом с combobox
            text_inp_id = await page.evaluate("""
                (el) => {
                    // Ищем в том же контейнере-секции
                    const container = el.closest(
                        '[class*="education"], [class*="section"], fieldset, ' +
                        '[class*="group"], [class*="row"], form'
                    ) || el.parentElement;
                    if (!container) return null;
                    const candidates = container.querySelectorAll(
                        'input[type="text"], input:not([type]):not([role="combobox"])'
                    );
                    for (const inp of candidates) {
                        // Пропускаем сам combobox и уже заполненные поля
                        if (inp === el) continue;
                        if (inp.offsetParent === null) continue;  // скрытый
                        if (inp.value.trim()) continue;           // уже заполнен
                        return inp.id || inp.name || '__found__';
                    }
                    return null;
                }
            """, combobox_el)

            if not text_inp_id:
                return
            if text_inp_id == '__found__':
                # Нет id/name — ищем через JS снова и кликаем напрямую
                await page.evaluate("""
                    (el) => {
                        const container = el.closest(
                            '[class*="education"], [class*="section"], fieldset, ' +
                            '[class*="group"], [class*="row"], form'
                        ) || el.parentElement;
                        if (!container) return;
                        const candidates = container.querySelectorAll(
                            'input[type="text"], input:not([type]):not([role="combobox"])'
                        );
                        for (const inp of candidates) {
                            if (inp === el || inp.offsetParent === null || inp.value.trim()) continue;
                            inp.focus();
                            inp.value = '';
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                """, combobox_el)
                await page.keyboard.type(value, delay=40)
                logger.info(f"✅ После 'Other' ({hint[:30]}): доп. поле → '{value}'")
                return

            sel = f"#{text_inp_id}" if not text_inp_id.startswith('[') else f"[name='{text_inp_id}']"
            text_el = await page.query_selector(sel)
            if text_el and await text_el.is_visible():
                await text_el.fill(value)
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
                logger.info(f"✅ После 'Other' ({hint[:30]}): #{text_inp_id} → '{value}'")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"_fill_after_other: {e}")

    async def _fill_select_native(self, element, value: str):
        """Заполнить нативный <select> — ищет опцию содержащую value."""
        if not value:
            return
        try:
            options = await element.evaluate(
                "el => Array.from(el.options).map(o => ({value: o.value, text: o.text}))"
            )
            for opt in options:
                if value.lower() in opt["text"].lower() or value.lower() in opt["value"].lower():
                    await element.select_option(value=opt["value"])
                    await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.2, 0.4))
                    return
            # Fallback: по label
            await element.select_option(label=value)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"select_native: {e}")

    async def _click_by_bbox(self, page, text: str, selectors: str) -> bool:
        """Найти элемент по тексту и кликнуть через координаты (самый надёжный способ).

        Обходит проблемы с React synthetic events, которые иногда игнорируют el.click().
        Координатный клик через page.mouse.click() всегда регистрируется браузером.
        """
        try:
            bbox = await page.evaluate("""
                (args) => {
                    const [text, sel] = args;
                    for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) {
                        if (el.offsetParent === null) continue;
                        const t = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim();
                        if (t.toLowerCase() === text.toLowerCase()) {
                            el.scrollIntoView({block: 'center', behavior: 'instant'});
                            const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                            return { x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2 };
                        }
                    }
                    return null;
                }
            """, [text, selectors])
            if bbox:
                await page.mouse.click(bbox["x"], bbox["y"])
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass
        return False

    async def _fill_combobox_el(self, page, element, value: str, label_hint: str = ""):
        """
        Заполнить React combobox — раз и навсегда.

        3-этапная стратегия:
          1. Click-open → ищем опцию БЕЗ ввода текста
             (Education-dropdown не поддерживает text-filter)
          2. Ввод текста → ищем опцию в отфильтрованном списке
             (Country, Work Auth поддерживают поиск)
          3. Keyboard fallback — Arrow Down + Enter
        """
        if not value:
            return
        _hint = label_hint or "?"

        # ── JS: получить все опции из видимого listbox ──────────────────────
        # Greenhouse использует CSS-классы ('-option') вместо role='option'
        GET_OPTS_JS = """
            (el) => {
                // Сначала пробуем aria-owns/aria-controls
                const ownedId = el.getAttribute('aria-owns') || el.getAttribute('aria-controls');
                let list = ownedId ? document.getElementById(ownedId) : null;
                if (!list) {
                    // Видимый listbox по role
                    for (const lb of document.querySelectorAll("[role='listbox']")) {
                        if (lb.offsetParent !== null) { list = lb; break; }
                    }
                }
                if (!list) {
                    // Видимый menu-контейнер (react-select / Greenhouse custom)
                    for (const m of document.querySelectorAll("[class*='menu']")) {
                        const cls = m.className || '';
                        if (m.offsetParent !== null && !cls.match(/control|container|indicator/i)) {
                            list = m; break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!list) return [];
                // Ищем опции: сначала role='option', потом CSS-class паттерн
                let opts = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll("[role='option']"));
                if (opts.length === 0) {
                    opts = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll("[class*='-option']")).filter(o => {
                        const cls = o.className || '';
                        return o.offsetParent !== null && !cls.match(/control|container|placeholder|group-heading/i);
                    });
                }
                return opts.map(o => ({ text: o.innerText.trim(), id: o.id || '' }));
            }
        """

        async def _wait_for_listbox(timeout_ms=3500):
            """Ждём появления хотя бы одной опции в listbox.

            Greenhouse использует CSS-классы вместо ARIA role='option',
            поэтому проверяем оба варианта.
            """
            try:
                await page.wait_for_selector(
                    "[role='listbox'] [role='option'], "
                    "[role='option'], "
                    "[class*='menu'] [class*='-option'], "
                    "[class*='option--is-focused'], "
                    "[class*='option--is-selected']",
                    timeout=timeout_ms,
                    state="attached",
                )
                return True
            except Exception:
                return False

            import re as _re

            # Сначала точное совпадение, потом по целому слову (избегаем male→female)
            for exact in (True, False):
                for opt in opts:
                    t = opt["text"].lower()
                    if exact:
                        matched = (t == val_lower)
                    else:
                        # word-boundary: "male" НЕ совпадёт с "female"
                        matched = bool(_re.search(r'\b' + _re.escape(val_lower) + r'\b', t))
                    if matched:
                        try:
                            # Клик по role safe (кавычки, спецсимволы)
                            await page.get_by_role(
                                "option", name=opt["text"], exact=True
                            ).first.click(timeout=2000)
                            await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.3, 0.5))

                                f"✅ Combobox '{_hint[:40]}': "
                                f"'{value}' → опция '{opt['text']}'"

                                            el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {bubbles: true}));

                                }
                            """, opt["text"])

                        try:

                            ):

            # ArrowDown на сфокусированном react-select input гарантированно открывает дропдаун

            variants=variants,
            company=ctx.get("company", ""),
            job_title=ctx.get("job_title", ""),
            default_idx=best_idx,
        )

    def record(
        self,

        tier: int, 
        selector: str = "", 
        miss: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        """Record a selector resolution attempt.
        
        Args:
            intent: e.g. "apply_button"
            tier: 1-4 on success (which tier resolved it), ignored if miss=True
            selector: the winning selector string (empty string on miss)
            miss: True if all tiers failed to find a visible element
                  
        Example success call: record("apply_button", 2, "button:has-text('Apply now')")
        Example miss call:    record("apply_button", 0, "", miss=True)
        """
        stats = self._stats.setdefault(intent, SelectorStats(intent=intent))
        stats.total_attempts += 1
        
        if miss:
            stats.misses += 1
        elif tier == 1:
            stats.tier1_hits += 1
        elif tier == 2:
            stats.tier2_hits += 1
        elif tier == 3:
            stats.tier3_hits += 1
        elif tier == 4:
            stats.tier4_hits += 1
        
        # Debounced disk write (max once per 30s)
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self._last_save >= 30.0:

    def check_degradation(self) -> List[DegradationAlert]:
        """Check for degraded selectors (hit rate < threshold).
        
        Returns:
            List of DegradationAlert for intents with low hit rates.
        """
        alerts: List[DegradationAlert] = []
        
        for intent, stats in self._stats.items():
            if stats.total_attempts < 3:
                # Need minimum attempts before alerting
                continue
            
            hits = (
                stats.tier1_hits + 
                stats.tier2_hits + 
                stats.tier3_hits + 
                stats.tier4_hits
            )
            hit_rate = hits / stats.total_attempts if stats.total_attempts > 0 else 0.0
            
            if hit_rate < self.DEGRADATION_THRESHOLD:
                alerts.append(DegradationAlert(
                    intent=intent,
                    hit_rate=hit_rate,
                    total_attempts=stats.total_attempts,
                    misses=stats.misses
                ))
        
        return alerts

        alerts: List[DegradationAlert] = []

    async def extract_semantic_snapshot(self, page: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Extract a semantic snapshot of form fields from a page.

        Uses JavaScript to extract: labels, field types, options, aria-labels.
        Does NOT use CSS classes - only semantic information.

        Returns:
            {"questions": [{"label", "field_type", "options", "aria_label"}, ...]}
        """
        js_code = """
        () => {
            const questions = [];

            function getLabelText(el) {
                if (el.id) {
                    const label = document.querySelector(`label[for="${el.id}"]`);
                    if (label) return label.textContent.trim();
                }
                const parentLabel = el.closest('label');
                if (parentLabel) return parentLabel.textContent.trim();
                if (el.getAttribute('aria-label')) {
                    return el.getAttribute('aria-label').trim();
                }
                if (el.placeholder) return el.placeholder.trim();
                if (el.name) return el.name.trim();
                return '';
            }

            function getFieldType(el) {
                const tagName = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
                if (tagName === 'textarea') return 'textarea';
                if (tagName === 'select') return 'select';
                if (tagName === 'input') {
                    const type = (el.type || 'text').toLowerCase();
                    if (type === 'radio') return 'radio';
                    if (type === 'checkbox') return 'checkbox';
                    if (type === 'number') return 'number';
                    return 'text';
                }
                return 'text';
            }

            function getOptions(el) {
                const type = getFieldType(el);
                if (type === 'select') {
                    return Array.from(el.options || []).map(o => o.text.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                }
                if (type === 'radio' || type === 'checkbox') {
                    const name = el.name;
                    const inputs = name ? document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${name}"]`) : [el];
                    const options = [];
                    inputs.forEach(input => {
                        const label = getLabelText(input);
                        if (label) options.push(label);
                    });
                    return options;
                }
                return [];
            }

            const selectors = [
                'input:not([type="hidden"]):not([type="submit"]):not([type="button"])',
                'textarea',
                'select'
            ];

            const seen = new Set();
            const seenRadioNames = new Set();
            document.querySelectorAll(selectors.join(', ')).forEach(el => {
                const key = el.id || el.name || `${el.tagName}-${seen.size}`;
                if (seen.has(key)) return;
                seen.add(key);

                const fieldType = getFieldType(el);
                // Track radio names to avoid duplication with fieldset pass
                if (fieldType === 'radio' && el.name) seenRadioNames.add(el.name);

                const label = getLabelText(el);
                const options = getOptions(el);
                const ariaLabel = el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';

                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.width === 0 && rect.height === 0) return;
                if (el.type === 'hidden') return;

                questions.push({
                    label: label,
                    field_type: fieldType,
                    options: options,
                    aria_label: ariaLabel,
                    required: el.required || el.hasAttribute('required')
                });
            });

            // Also find fieldsets/legend for radio groups (skip already-seen radio names)
            document.querySelectorAll('fieldset').forEach(fieldset => {
                const legend = fieldset.querySelector('legend');
                if (!legend) return;
                const radios = fieldset.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]');
                if (radios.length === 0) return;
                if (radios[0].name && seenRadioNames.has(radios[0].name)) return;
                const labelText = legend.textContent.trim();
                const options = [];
                radios.forEach(radio => {
                    const label = getLabelText(radio);
                    if (label) options.push(label);
                });
                questions.push({
                    label: labelText,
                    field_type: 'radio',
                    options: options,
                    aria_label: '',
                    required: fieldset.hasAttribute('required') || radios[0]?.required
                });
            });

            return { questions: questions };
        }
        """
        try:
            result = await page.evaluate(js_code)
            logger.debug(f"Extracted {len(result.get('questions', []))} form fields")
            return result
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to extract semantic snapshot: {e}")
            return {"questions": []}

    async def analyze_and_map(
        self,
        page: Any,
        profile: Dict[str, Any],
        snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> List[FormAction]:
        """
        Analyze form fields and map profile data to form values using Gemini.

        Returns:
            List of FormAction dicts with label, field_type, and value
        """
        if snapshot is None:
            snapshot = await self.extract_semantic_snapshot(page)

        questions = snapshot.get("questions", [])
        if not questions:
            logger.warning("No questions found in snapshot")
            return []

        prompt = f"""Analyze these form fields and map candidate profile data to form values.

Form Fields:
{json.dumps(questions, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)}

Candidate Profile:
{json.dumps(profile, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)}

For each field, determine the appropriate value from the profile.
Rules:
1. For text/textarea: write concise, factual answers from profile
2. For select/radio: choose ONE option that best matches profile
3. For checkbox: set value to "true" if applies, "false" if not
4. For number: use numeric value from profile

Respond with JSON array only, no markdown:
[
  {{"label": "field label", "field_type": "text", "value": "answer"}},
  ...
]

JSON response:"""

        try:
            response = await self.gemini.generate(prompt)

            json_str = response.strip()
            if "```json" in json_str:
                json_str = json_str.split("```json")[1].split("```")[0]
            elif "```" in json_str:
                json_str = json_str.split("```")[1].split("```")[0]

            actions = json.loads(json_str.strip())

            valid_actions = []
            for action in actions:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                if "label" not in action or "value" not in action:
                    continue
                valid_actions.append({
                    "label": str(action["label"]),
                    "field_type": str(action.get("field_type", "text")),
                    "value": str(action["value"]),
                })

            logger.info(f"Mapped {len(valid_actions)} fields via Gemini")
            return valid_actions

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Gemini analyze_and_map error: {e}")

            if question.options:

            else:

    def get_answer(self, question: str) -> str | None:
        """
        Find an answer to a question using fuzzy matching.
        Returns None if no answer found, empty string if answer is intentionally blank.

        Strategy:
        1. Normalize question (lower, strip)
        2. Search for keywords from our dictionary

        Args:
            question: The form question text

        Returns:
            Answer string (may be empty) or None if not found
        """
        q = question.lower().strip()

        # Fast path: if the question IS a direct key in _data (e.g. "first_name"),
        # return immediately without running regex patterns.
        if q in self._data:
            answer = self._data[q]
            logger.debug(f"🎯 AnswerBank (direct): '{q}' → '{answer}'")
            return answer

        for pattern, key in self.KEYWORD_PATTERNS.items():
            if re.search(pattern, q):
                answer = self._data.get(key)
                if answer is not None:  # None = key missing; "" = intentionally blank
                    logger.debug(f"🎯 AnswerBank: '{question[:50]}...' → '{answer}'")
                    return answer

        logger.warning(f"⚠️ AnswerBank: no answer for '{question[:80]}'")
        return None

    def get_yes_no(self, question: str, default: str = "Yes") -> str:
        """
        For Yes/No checkbox/radio questions.
        Returns 'Yes' or 'No'.
        
        Args:
            question: The form question text
            default: Default value if no answer found
            
        Returns:
            'Yes' or 'No'
        """
        answer = self.get_answer(question)
        if answer in ("Yes", "No"):
            return answer
        return default

    def get_answer_for_options(self, question: str, options: List[str], default: str = "Yes") -> str:
        """
        Like get_yes_no, but maps the answer to the best matching option from
        the real radio-button list.  Handles variants like:
          ["Strong No", "No", "Yes", "Strong Yes"]

        Priority:
        1. Exact match in options (e.g. "Yes" → "Yes")
        2. Options that START WITH the answer (e.g. "Yes" → "Yes" before "Strong Yes")
        3. Options that CONTAIN the answer anywhere
        4. Default

        Args:
            question: The form question text
            options:  Actual radio labels from the page
            default:  Fallback if no match found

        Returns:
            Option string from `options` list
        """
        answer = self.get_yes_no(question, default)
        answer_lower = answer.lower().strip()
        options_lower = [o.lower().strip() for o in options]

        # 1. Exact match
        if answer_lower in options_lower:
            return options[options_lower.index(answer_lower)]

        # 2. Options that start with the answer word (e.g. "yes " prefix)
        for i, ol in enumerate(options_lower):
            if ol.startswith(answer_lower):
                return options[i]

        # 3. Substring match — but prefer SHORTER options ("Yes" before "Strong Yes")
        matches = [(len(ol), i) for i, ol in enumerate(options_lower) if answer_lower in ol]
        if matches:
            matches.sort()
            return options[matches[0][1]]

        return default

    def get_years_for_dropdown(self, question: str, options: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> str:
        """
        Get years of experience and convert to dropdown option.
        Uses aggressive rounding UP strategy (picks one tier above actual).

        Args:
            question: The form question text
            options: Actual dropdown options from the form (if provided, matches against them)

        Returns:
            Dropdown option string
        """
        answer = self.get_answer(question)
        try:
            years = int(answer) if answer else 0
        except ValueError:
            years = 0

        if not options:
            return self._years_to_tier(years)

        return self._best_option_for_years(years, options)

    def _years_to_tier(self, years: int) -> str:
        """Convert integer years to generic tier string (aggressive round-up)."""
        if years == 0:
            return "Less than 1 year"
        elif years == 1:
            return "1 year"
        elif years <= 2:
            return "1-2 years"

    def _load_skills_text(self, max_chars: int = 2000) -> str:
        """Load and concatenate skills/*.md and experience/*.md files for AI context."""
        texts = []
        for directory in (SKILLS_DIR, EXPERIENCE_DIR):
            if not directory.exists():
                continue
            for md_file in sorted(directory.glob("*.md")):
                try:
                    content = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
                    if content:

    async def ask(
        self,
        question: str,
        field_type: str = "radio",
        options: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[AIAnswer]:
        """
        Ответить на вопрос формы через Gemini.

        Args:
            question: Текст вопроса
            field_type: radio, select, text, number, textarea, checkbox
            options: Доступные варианты (для radio/select)
            context: Доп. контекст {job_title, company, url, skills_content}

        Returns:
            AIAnswer или None при ошибке
        """
        # Проверить кэш
        q_hash = self._question_hash(question, options or [])
        if q_hash in self._cache:
            logger.info(f"🎯 AI cache: '{question[:50]}' → '{self._cache[q_hash]}'")
            return AIAnswer(answer=self._cache[q_hash], confidence="high",
                            reason="Cached", cached=True)

        profile_text = self._format_profile()

            prompt = self.SYSTEM_PROMPT.format(profile=profile_text)
        except KeyError:
            # Fallback если в профиле есть фигурные скобки
            prompt = self.SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("{profile}", profile_text)

        prompt += f"\nТИП ПОЛЯ: {field_type}"
        if options:
            prompt += f"\nДОСТУПНЫЕ ВАРИАНТЫ: {', '.join(options)}"
        if context:
            if context.get("job_title"):
                prompt += f"\nВАКАНСИЯ: {context['job_title']}"
            if context.get("company"):
                prompt += f"\nКОМПАНИЯ: {context['company']}"
            if context.get("skills_content"):
                prompt += f"\n\nКОНТЕКСТ (навыки кандидата):\n{context['skills_content']}"

        prompt += "\n\nОТВЕТ JSON:"

        try:
            text = await self._gemini.generate(prompt)
            text = text.strip()

            # Убрать markdown если есть
            if "```json" in text:
                text = text.split("```json")[1].split("```")[0]
            elif "```" in text:
                text = text.split("```")[1].split("```")[0]

            result = json.loads(text.strip())
            answer = AIAnswer(
                answer=str(result.get("answer", "")),
                confidence=result.get("confidence", "medium"),
                reason=result.get("reason", ""),

            self._log_unknown(question, field_type, options or [], answer, context or {})

            return answer

        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ AIAnswerer JSON parse error: {e} | text={text[:200]}")
            return None
        except Exception as e:

    async def ask_variants(

            if context.get("company"):
                parts.append(f"КОМПАНИЯ: {context['company']}")
            context_line = " | ".join(parts)
            if context.get("skills_content"):

        # Всегда используем .replace() — избегаем KeyError если профиль
        # содержит фигурные скобки (JSON-фрагменты в skills/*.md)
        prompt = (

            .replace("{profile}", profile_text)
            .replace("{question}", question)
            .replace("{field_type}", field_type)
            .replace("{options_line}", options_line)
            .replace("{context_line}", context_line)
            .replace("{skills_line}", skills_line)
        )

        try:
            text = await self._gemini.generate(prompt)
            text = text.strip()

            elif "```" in text:
                text = text.split("```")[1].split("```")[0]

            variants = result.get("variants", [])
            best = result.get("best", 0)

            if not variants:
                raise ValueError("No variants in response")

            best = max(0, min(best, len(variants) - 1))
            logger.debug(f"🎲 ask_variants: '{question[:50]}' → {len(variants)} variants, best={best}")

            # Логируем ТОЛЬКО при успешном парсинге — если упадём в fallback ask(),
            # тот сам залогирует через _log_unknown. Двойной лог исключён.
            _log_answer = AIAnswer(answer=variants[best], confidence="high", reason="ask_variants")
            self._log_unknown(question, field_type, options or [], _log_answer, context or {})

        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, KeyError) as e:
            logger.warning(f"⚠️ ask_variants JSON parse error: {e}, fallback to ask()")

            if single:

            return ["Please see my resume for details."], 0
        except Exception as e:

            logger.warning(f"ask_variants fallback to hardcoded string: {question[:60]}")
            return ["Please see my resume for details."], 0

    def _log_unknown(

    - Yes/No вопросы о квалификации → Yes по умолчанию
    - Числовые → из профиля, округлять вверх
    - Dropdown ranges → тир выше реального
    - Исключение: явно нерелевантный домен (CDL, RN-лицензия) → No

    Кэш: custom_answers.json (MD5 hash вопроса → ответ)
    Лог: unknown_questions.json (для ревью)
    """

    SYSTEM_PROMPT = """Ты помогаешь кандидату пройти ATS-фильтр.

ПРОФИЛЬ КАНДИДАТА:
{profile}

СТРАТЕГИЯ (СТРОГО СЛЕДОВАТЬ):
1. Для yes/no вопросов о квалификации → "Yes" если нет очевидного противоречия с профилем
2. Для числовых вопросов → используй данные из профиля, округляй ВВЕРХ
3. Для dropdown с диапазонами → выбери диапазон ВЫШЕ реального опыта
4. 0 лет опыта → "Less than 1 year", никогда "No experience"
5. Вопрос про явно другой домен (медицина, юриспруденция, CDL-лицензия) → "No"
6. Для текстовых полей (textarea / cover letter / open-ended) → пиши ТОЛЬКО чистый текст на английском, 2-4 предложения, БЕЗ markdown, БЕЗ YAML, БЕЗ заголовков, БЕЗ bullets. Краткий профессиональный ответ по теме вопроса.
7. Цель: максимизировать прохождение автоматического ATS-фильтра

ВАЖНО для Education полей:
- "School" или "Name of School" = НАЗВАНИЕ учебного заведения (пример: "Bunker Hill Community College"), НЕ степень!
- "Degree" = уровень диплома (пример: "High School Diploma", "Associate's Degree")
- "Discipline" / "Field of Study" / "Major" = специальность (пример: "Information Technology")
- "Start date year" / "End date year" в контексте Education = годы учёбы из профиля

ФОРМАТ ОТВЕТА (только JSON, без markdown):
{{"answer": "точный текст ответа", "confidence": "high|medium|low", "reason": "одна строка"}}"""

    def __init__(self, profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        self.profile = profile or {}
        self._gemini = GeminiClient()
        self._cache = self._load_cache()
        self._unknown_log = self._load_unknown_log()

    # ── Cache ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _load_cache(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        if CACHE_PATH.exists():
            try:
                with open(CACHE_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    return json.load(f).get("answers", {})
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"⚠️ AIAnswerer: cache load error: {e}")
        return {}

    def _save_cache(self):
        CACHE_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(CACHE_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"answers": self._cache}, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    def _load_unknown_log(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if UNKNOWN_LOG_PATH.exists():
            try:
                with open(UNKNOWN_LOG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return []

    def _save_unknown_log(self):
        UNKNOWN_LOG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(UNKNOWN_LOG_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self._unknown_log, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    def _question_hash(self, question: str, options: List[str]) -> str:
        text = f"{question.lower().strip()}|{'|'.join(sorted(o.lower() for o in options))}"
        return hashlib.md5(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

    # ── Profile formatting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _format_profile(self) -> str:
        lines = []
        p = self.profile

        personal = p.get("personal", {})
        if personal.get("first_name"):
            lines.append(f"Имя: {personal['first_name']} {personal.get('last_name', '')}")
        if personal.get("email"):
            lines.append(f"Email: {personal['email']}")
        if personal.get("city"):
            lines.append(f"Город: {personal['city']}")
        if personal.get("country"):
            lines.append(f"Страна: {personal['country']}")

        # Education section — CRITICAL for Greenhouse Education block
        edu = p.get("education", {})
        if edu:
            edu_lines = []
            if edu.get("school"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Учебное заведение (School): {edu['school']}")
            if edu.get("degree"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Степень (Degree): {edu['degree']}")
            if edu.get("discipline"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Специальность (Discipline/Field of Study): {edu['discipline']}")
            if edu.get("start_month"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Месяц начала учёбы (Start month): {edu['start_month']}")
            if edu.get("start_year"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Год начала учёбы (Start year): {edu['start_year']}")
            if edu.get("end_month"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Месяц окончания учёбы (End month): {edu['end_month']}")
            if edu.get("end_year"):
                edu_lines.append(f"  Год окончания учёбы (End year): {edu['end_year']}")
            if edu_lines:
                lines.append("Образование:\n" + "\n".join(edu_lines))

        exp = p.get("experience", {})
        if exp:
            years_lines = [
                f"  {k.replace('years_', '').replace('_', ' ').title()}: {v}"
                for k, v in exp.items() if k.startswith("years_") and v
            ]
            if years_lines:
                lines.append("Опыт (лет):\n" + "\n".join(years_lines))

        certs = p.get("certifications", {})
        if certs:
            cert_lines = [
                f"  {k.replace('has_', '').replace('_', ' ').title()}: {'Да' if v else 'Нет'}"
                for k, v in certs.items()
            ]
            lines.append("Сертификаты:\n" + "\n".join(cert_lines))

        work = p.get("work_conditions", {})
        if work:
            work_lines = [
                f"  {k.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {'Да' if v else 'Нет'}"
                for k, v in work.items()
            ]
            lines.append("Условия работы:\n" + "\n".join(work_lines))

        # Skills files from data/candidate/skills/*.md
        skills_text = self._load_skills_text()
        if skills_text:
            lines.append(f"Навыки и опыт (из файлов):\n{skills_text}")

        return "\n".join(lines) or "Профиль не загружен"

    def _load_skills_text(self, max_chars: int = 2000) -> str:
        """Load and concatenate skills/*.md and experience/*.md files for AI context."""
        texts = []
        for directory in (SKILLS_DIR, EXPERIENCE_DIR):
            if not directory.exists():
                continue
            for md_file in sorted(directory.glob("*.md")):
                try:
                    content = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
                    if content:
                        texts.append(f"[{md_file.stem}]\n{content}")
                except Exception:
                    pass
        combined = "\n\n".join(texts)
        return combined[:max_chars] if combined else ""

    # ── Main API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    async def ask(
        self,
        question: str,
        field_type: str = "radio",
        options: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[AIAnswer]:
        """
        Ответить на вопрос формы через Gemini.

        Args:
            question: Текст вопроса
            field_type: radio, select, text, number, textarea, checkbox
            options: Доступные варианты (для radio/select)
            context: Доп. контекст {job_title, company, url, skills_content}

        Returns:
            AIAnswer или None при ошибке
        """
        # Проверить кэш
        q_hash = self._question_hash(question, options or [])
        if q_hash in self._cache:
            logger.info(f"🎯 AI cache: '{question[:50]}' → '{self._cache[q_hash]}'")
            return AIAnswer(answer=self._cache[q_hash], confidence="high",
                            reason="Cached", cached=True)

        # Собрать промпт (ВАЖНО: использовать replace, не format — профиль может содержать {})
        profile_text = self._format_profile()
        try:
            prompt = self.SYSTEM_PROMPT.format(profile=profile_text)
        except KeyError:
            # Fallback если в профиле есть фигурные скобки
            prompt = self.SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("{profile}", profile_text)
        prompt += f"\n\nВОПРОС: {question}"
        prompt += f"\nТИП ПОЛЯ: {field_type}"
        if options:
            prompt += f"\nДОСТУПНЫЕ ВАРИАНТЫ: {', '.join(options)}"
        if context:
            if context.get("job_title"):
                prompt += f"\nВАКАНСИЯ: {context['job_title']}"
            if context.get("company"):
                prompt += f"\nКОМПАНИЯ: {context['company']}"
            if context.get("skills_content"):
                prompt += f"\n\nКОНТЕКСТ (навыки кандидата):\n{context['skills_content']}"

        prompt += "\n\nОТВЕТ JSON:"

        try:
            text = await self._gemini.generate(prompt)
            text = text.strip()

            # Убрать markdown если есть
            if "```json" in text:
                text = text.split("```json")[1].split("```")[0]
            elif "```" in text:
                text = text.split("```")[1].split("```")[0]

            result = json.loads(text.strip())
            answer = AIAnswer(
                answer=str(result.get("answer", "")),
                confidence=result.get("confidence", "medium"),
                reason=result.get("reason", ""),
            )

            # Логировать в unknown_questions
            self._log_unknown(question, field_type, options or [], answer, context or {})

            logger.info(f"🤖 Gemini: '{question[:50]}' → '{answer.answer}' ({answer.confidence})")
            return answer

        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ AIAnswerer JSON parse error: {e} | text={text[:200]}")
            return None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ AIAnswerer error: {e}")
            return None

    async def ask_variants(
        self,
        question: str,
        field_type: str = "textarea",
        options: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> tuple:
        """
        Сгенерировать 4 варианта ответа для HITL-меню.

        Returns:
            (List[str], int) — список вариантов и 0-based индекс лучшего.
            При ошибке → fallback: ask() → ([один ответ], 0)
        """
        profile_text = self._format_profile()
        options_line = f"ДОСТУПНЫЕ ВАРИАНТЫ: {', '.join(options)}" if options else ""
        context_line = ""
        skills_line = ""
        if context:
            parts = []
            if context.get("job_title"):
                parts.append(f"ВАКАНСИЯ: {context['job_title']}")
            if context.get("company"):
                parts.append(f"КОМПАНИЯ: {context['company']}")
            context_line = " | ".join(parts)
            if context.get("skills_content"):
                skills_line = f"КОНТЕКСТ НАВЫКОВ:\n{context['skills_content'][:800]}"

        # Всегда используем .replace() — избегаем KeyError если профиль
        # содержит фигурные скобки (JSON-фрагменты в skills/*.md)
        prompt = (
            VARIANTS_PROMPT
            .replace("{profile}", profile_text)
            .replace("{question}", question)
            .replace("{field_type}", field_type)
            .replace("{options_line}", options_line)
            .replace("{context_line}", context_line)
            .replace("{skills_line}", skills_line)
        )

        try:
            text = await self._gemini.generate(prompt)
            text = text.strip()

            if "```json" in text:
                text = text.split("```json")[1].split("```")[0]
            elif "```" in text:
                text = text.split("```")[1].split("```")[0]

            result = json.loads(text.strip())
            variants = result.get("variants", [])
            best = result.get("best", 0)

            if not variants:
                raise ValueError("No variants in response")

            best = max(0, min(best, len(variants) - 1))
            logger.debug(f"🎲 ask_variants: '{question[:50]}' → {len(variants)} variants, best={best}")

            # Логируем ТОЛЬКО при успешном парсинге — если упадём в fallback ask(),
            # тот сам залогирует через _log_unknown. Двойной лог исключён.
            _log_answer = AIAnswer(answer=variants[best], confidence="high", reason="ask_variants")
            self._log_unknown(question, field_type, options or [], _log_answer, context or {})

            return variants, best

        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, KeyError) as e:
            logger.warning(f"⚠️ ask_variants JSON parse error: {e}, fallback to ask()")
            single = await self.ask(question, field_type, options, context)
            if single:
                return [single.answer], 0
            logger.warning(f"ask_variants fallback to hardcoded string: {question[:60]}")
            return ["Please see my resume for details."], 0
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ ask_variants error: {e}")
            logger.warning(f"ask_variants fallback to hardcoded string: {question[:60]}")
            return ["Please see my resume for details."], 0

    # ── Log ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _log_unknown(
        self,
        question: str,
        field_type: str,
        options: List[str],
        answer: AIAnswer,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
    ):
        q_hash = self._question_hash(question, options)
        existing_ids = {e.get("id") for e in self._unknown_log}
        if q_hash in existing_ids:
            return  # уже залогировано

        entry = {
            "id": q_hash,
            "question": question,
            "field_type": field_type,
            "options": options,
            "url": context.get("url", ""),
            "company": context.get("company", ""),
            "job_title": context.get("job_title", ""),
            "ai_answered": answer.answer,
            "ai_confidence": answer.confidence,
            "ai_reason": answer.reason,
            "my_answer": None,
            "status": "pending_review",
        }
        self._unknown_log.append(entry)
        self._save_unknown_log()

    # ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def get_cached_answer(self, question: str, options: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Optional[str]:
        q_hash = self._question_hash(question, options or [])
        return self._cache.get(q_hash)

    def set_cached_answer(self, question: str, answer: str, options: Optional[List[str]] = None):
        q_hash = self._question_hash(question, options or [])
        self._cache[q_hash] = answer
        self._save_cache()
        logger.info(f"📝 AIAnswerer: cached '{question[:50]}' → '{answer}'")

    def get_unknown_questions(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self._unknown_log.copy()

    def confirm_answer(self, question_id: str, my_answer: Optional[str] = None):
        for entry in self._unknown_log:
            if entry.get("id") == question_id:
                if my_answer:
                    entry["my_answer"] = my_answer
                    entry["status"] = "overridden"
                    self._cache[question_id] = my_answer
                    self._save_cache()
                else:
                    entry["status"] = "confirmed"
                self._save_unknown_log()
                return
        logger.warning(f"⚠️ AIAnswerer: question {question_id} not found")"

        if not apply_url:
            return {"success": False, "error": "no_apply_url"}

        try:
            async with StealthBrowser(headed=True) as browser:
                async with await browser.new_context() as ctx:
                    page = await browser.new_page(ctx)
                    await page.goto(apply_url, wait_until="networkidle")
                    await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(1.5, 3.0))

                    await self._fill(page, self.SELECTORS["email"],
                        self.bank._data.get("email", ""))
                    await self._fill(page, self.SELECTORS["phone"],
                        self.bank._data.get("phone", ""))

                    # Местоположение (autocomplete — требует особого подхода)
                    await self._fill_location(page, self.bank._data.get("city", ""))

                    # Загрузить резюме
                    file_input = await page.query_selector(self.SELECTORS["resume"])
                    if file_input:
                        await file_input.set_input_files(str(resume_file))
                        await asyncio.sleep(gaussian_delay(0.5, 1.5))

                    # Кастомные вопросы через AI (text/select/radio/checkbox + Gemini + HITL)
                    context = {
                        "job_title": job.title,
                        "company": job.company,
                        "url": job.apply_url,

                    await self.screening.handle_all_questions(page, context)

    """
    Self-healing element finder with 4-tier resolution and honeypot filtering.
    
    Tier 1: Cached selector (previous success)
    Tier 2: Semantic selectors (ARIA, text, role)
    Tier 3: Structural selectors (data-testid, CSS classes)
    Tier 4: LLM discovery (Gemini Flash)
    
    Cache TTL: 24 hours
    Concurrent-safe: Uses asyncio.Lock for all cache operations
    """

    CACHE_FILE = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "data" / "selector_cache.json"
    _CACHE_SAVE_DEBOUNCE: float = 30.0  # max one disk write per 30s

    def __init__(
        self,
        health_monitor: Optional[SelectorHealthMonitor] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialize SelectorEngine.

        Args:
            health_monitor: Optional health monitor for tracking stats.
                           If None, stats are not recorded.
        """
        self._health = health_monitor
        self._cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}  # {intent: {selector: str, ts: float}}
        self._cache_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._last_save: float = 0.0  # monotonic timestamp of last cache write (debounce)

        self.CACHE_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def pause(self):
        """Pause the queue processing."""
        self._paused = True
        logger.info("⏸ QueueManager: paused")

    def resume(self):
        """Resume the queue processing."""
        self._paused = False
        logger.info("▶️ QueueManager: resumed")

    def is_paused(self) -> bool:
        """Check if the queue is paused."""
        return self._paused

    async def run_loop(self):
        """
        Infinite queue processing loop.
        Run in asyncio.gather() with Telegram bot.
        """
        self._running = True
        logger.info("🔄 QueueManager loop started")

        while self._running:
            try:
                await self._tick()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"❌ QueueManager tick error: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(60)  # Check queue every minute

    def stop(self):
        """Stop the queue processing loop."""
        self._running = False
        logger.info("🛑 QueueManager stopped")

    async def _tick(self):
        """One cycle of queue processing."""
        if self._paused:
            return

        # Check work hours
        if not is_work_hours():
            return
        
        # Use async db if available
        if self.db is None:
            return

        # Check daily limit
        today_count = await self.db.count_applied_today()
        
        if self.warmup:
            daily_limit = self.warmup.get_daily_limit()
            if asyncio.iscoroutine(daily_limit):
                daily_limit = await daily_limit

            if today_count >= daily_limit:
                logger.debug(f"🛑 Daily limit reached: {today_count}/{daily_limit}")
                return

        # Get next job from queue
        queued = await self.db.get_by_status("queued")
        if not queued:
            return

        job = queued[0]
        logger.info(f"🎯 Processing: {job['title']} @ {job['company']}")

        # Apply to job
        result = await self._process_job(job)

        # Notify via Telegram
        if self.notify:
            await self._send_notification(job, result)

        # Delay between applications (only on success)
        if result == ApplicationResult.SUCCESS:
            wait_sec = gaussian_delay(self.DELAY_MIN_SEC, self.DELAY_MAX_SEC)
            logger.info(f"💤 Pausing {wait_sec/60:.0f} minutes until next application")
            await asyncio.sleep(wait_sec)
